messages:
maya: quick idea — a tiny helper flow to speed up previews and release notes. thinking /deploy quick-preview that does a dry-run, spits out a release-notes draft, and optionally pins the tag for the canary window. short CLI + bot integration.

maya: goal is low-friction: dev runs preview locally or from CI, bot replies with checklist + notes draft + a preview link. no full rollout yet.

jon: +1. can we make change-window enforcement mandatory for pinned deploys? avoid midnight surprises. :raised_hands:

priya: agree on change-window. also suggest auto-preflight step that runs smoke tests + signature check. if smoke fails, block pin and add rollback suggestion to notes.

ashley: sample UX: `/deploy quick-preview srv-api --tag v2.3.1 --pin --dry-run --change-window "2026-03-21T02:00Z/02:30Z"` -> bot posts: preview URL, generated release-notes.md, & preflight report.

sam: what about rollback automation? if canary exceeds thresholds, we should include an easy `--rollforward` vs `--rollback` command in the reply thread. bot could surface the exact `deployctl rollback --to tag` command.

deploy-bot: registered command: /deploy quick-preview (alpha). flags: --tag, --pin, --dry-run, --change-window, --smoke, --notes-template. Example usage posted below.

maya: here's a tiny helper script prototype for CI/sre to iterate on:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
SERVICE=$1
TAG=$2
# run preview + notesgen
deployctl preview --service "$SERVICE" --tag "$TAG" --dry-run --smoke || { echo "preflight failed"; exit 1; }
notesgen --service "$SERVICE" --tag "$TAG" --out release-notes.md
# if pin requested, ask bot to reserve change window
# ./deployctl pin --service "$SERVICE" --tag "$TAG" --change-window "$3"
```

priya: notesgen should include structured rollout plan + rollback criteria. something like:

```
Summary: Short summary of change
Rollout: canary 5% (30m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100%
Metrics: p50 latency, error-rate, CPU
Rollback criteria: error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p50 > baseline + 30%
Runbook: exact rollback command and contacts
```

jon: small UX nit: bot should include a one-click 'pin for window' button that translates to `deployctl pin ...` under the hood. less typing in oncall pages.

ashley: also add `--notes-from-commit` to prefill Summary from PR title/body. reduces manual typing.

maya: implementation plan proposal: 1) add quick-preview to deploy-bot (alpha) 2) add notesgen simple template + CLI flag 3) change-window enforcement + pin API 4) preflight smoke integration 5) one-click pin/rollback actions in threads.

sam: timeline? can we get an alpha in 2 weeks? I can help with the bot webhooks.

maya: pinging @priya and @jon for design + SLO thresholds. I'll open a draft PR with the script and a docs stub later today. volunteers for code review? :rocket:

priya: I can review the notes template and thresholds.

jon: I'll take the pin API + change-window enforcement.

deploy-bot: note: example quick-preview command output (mock):

---
deploy-bot: Preview started for srv-api:v2.3.1
Preview URL: https://preview.prod.redwood/srv-api/tx/abcdef
Preflight: PASSED (smoke tests)
Release notes draft: attached (release-notes.md)
Pin suggestion: use `/deploy pin srv-api --tag v2.3.1 --window 2026-03-21T02:00Z/02:30Z`
One-click actions: [Pin for window] [Rollback to v2.3.0]
---

maya: great — I'll push an initial PR: refs will be in #repo/deploy-bot and #repo/tools/notesgen. small docs page + template.

sam: thanks. do we want an automated lint check for release-notes.md format?

ashley: yes please, have notesgen emit a JSON schema and a small validator. CI fails if missing required fields.

maya: ok team — i'll post the PR link here once opened. thanks for the quick feedback.
